text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high QPS spike observed on embeddings.route=enterprise-vecs starting +2m. Error rate stable but backend latency > 2s for a subset of pods. Auto-scale pending.

alex-oncall: I'm on it, looking at routing console and queue length. Notifying SRE.

sam-sre: seeing a concentrated source — a single customer token (~token: cust_9XYZ) is responsible for ~45% of recent embed requests.

nisha-eng: if it's one token, we can apply a per-token limit quickly or carve route capacity. Recommend temporary quota cap on enterprise-vecs and shift spare to chat-priority routes.

alex-oncall: agree. Plan: 1) carve 40% qps away from enterprise-vecs route, 2) add per-token throttle for cust_9XYZ to 20 QPS, 3) monitor 1m latency.

lina-support: flagging customer-impact: a few paying customers using embeddings may see degraded throughput; CS will message major customers if degradation > 5m.

sam-sre: executing carve now: 
``` 
POST /admin/routes/enterprise-vecs/quota
{ "action": "set", "qps": "60" }
```
(Existing qps was 100)

ops-bot: route quota update: enterprise-vecs qps -> 60 applied by sam-sre at 5567001250.

alex-oncall: adding per-token throttle for cust_9XYZ: 
``` 
POST /admin/tokens/cust_9XYZ/throttle
{ "qps": 20, "burst": 40, "reason": "live-mitigation embeddings surge" }
```

ops-bot: token throttle applied: cust_9XYZ -> 20 qps by alex-oncall at 5567001260.

nisha-eng: also toggling rerank route weight to avoid cascading latency. Setting rerank route to read-only for low-priority calls.

sam-sre: metrics: tail latency down from 2.3s -> 700ms within ~40s of carve. Error rate unchanged. Good signal.

alex-oncall: CS, pls prepare one-line blurb: "We're mitigating an internal embedding traffic surge; you may see slower responses for embeddings for a few minutes." Lina, can you send if >5m?

lina-support: noted. I'll hold unless we hit the 5m threshold.

alex-oncall: tagging next oncall for handoff if this persists: @nisha-eng you'll take the 4:00-8:00UTC shift — if tail latency climbs above 1s for >3 consecutive minutes, escalate to infra.

nisha-eng: taking handoff. I'll start a focused trace on the offending token and check if requests are batched client-side.

alex-oncall: leaving the channel — markers: mitigation applied, observed improvement, customer-impact set to potential short slowdowns, handoff to nisha-eng. Closing when stable for 10m. :white_check_mark:
